title: Max Area of Island
prompt:
Same grid setup as Number of Islands (here with int 0/1), but return the **area of the largest island** (0 if there's no land).

The twist: the DFS now *returns a value* — the size of the region it flooded. Compare with tree DFS: same combine-the-recursion shape.
hints: dfs returns an int: 0 for out-of-bounds/water, else 1 + the four recursive areas.
The scan loop takes `best = Math.max(best, dfs(r, c))` for every cell.

solution.explanation: Identical traversal to Number of Islands, but the DFS aggregates a value instead of just marking — the grid version of `treeSum`. O(m·n).
